name: Dungeon boss kit spells cast at a single enemy reach 30 yards instead of 100
contract: Ascension's kit spells for vanilla dungeon bosses mostly have SpellRange 6 (100 yards) in Spell.dbc, so casters hit from
across the room or beyond. Our tester asked for 30 yards on every kit spell that targets a single enemy. These 19 spells
get SpellRange 4 through coa_dungeon_spell_reach. Room-wide mechanics keep their range.
